sanskrit.deva:
अथ हैनं भार्गवो वैदर्भिः पप्रच्छ ।
भगवन्कत्येव देवाः प्रजां विधारयन्ते ।
कतर एतत्प्रकाशयन्ते ।
कः पुनरेषां वरिष्ठ इति ॥ १ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
atha hainaṃ bhārgavo vaidarbhiḥ papraccha |
bhagavan katyeva devāḥ prajāṃ vidhārayante |
katara etat prakāśayante |
kaḥ punar eṣāṃ variṣṭha iti || 1 ||

lines.iast: atha hainaṃ bhārgavo vaidarbhiḥ papraccha
bhagavan katyeva devāḥ prajāṃ vidhārayante
katara etat prakāśayante
kaḥ punar eṣāṃ variṣṭha iti

padaccheda.iast: atha ha enam bhārgavaḥ vaidarbhiḥ papraccha bhagavan kati eva devāḥ prajām vidhārayante katare etat prakāśayante kaḥ punaḥ eṣām variṣṭhaḥ iti
padaccheda.deva: अथ ह एनम् भार्गवः वैदर्भिः पप्रच्छ भगवन् कति एव देवाः प्रजाम् विधारयन्ते कतरे एतत् प्रकाशयन्ते कः पुनः एषाम् वरिष्ठः इति

translations.text: Then Bhārgava of Vidarbha asked him: ‘Venerable sir, how many gods uphold the creature (the body)? Which of them make this (their greatness) manifest? And who among them is the chief?’

notes: Śaṅkara, introducing the praśna: it has been said that prāṇa is the eater, Prajāpati. That he is Prajāpati and the eater is to be ascertained in this body; for that this question is begun.

Śaṅkara: prajā here is the body. vidhārayante: uphold in a special way. ‘Which make this manifest’: which of them, divided into organs of knowledge and organs of action, make manifest this, the proclaiming of their own greatness. ‘The chief of these’: of those that are effects and instruments.
The e-text reads ata hainaṃ; it is set right here to atha hainaṃ, as the bhāṣya has it.

sanskrit.deva:
तस्मै स होवाच ।
आकाशो ह वा एष देवो वायुरग्निरापः पृथिवी वाङ्मनश्चक्षुः श्रोत्रं च ।
ते प्रकाश्याभिवदन्ति ।
वयमेतद्बाणमवष्टभ्य विधारयामः ॥ २ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
tasmai sa hovāca |
ākāśo ha vā eṣa devo vāyur agnir āpaḥ pṛthivī vāṅ manaś cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ ca |
te prakāśyābhivadanti |
vayam etad bāṇam avaṣṭabhya vidhārayāmaḥ || 2 ||

lines.iast: tasmai sa hovāca
ākāśo ha vā eṣa devo vāyur agnir āpaḥ pṛthivī vāṅ manaś cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ ca
lines.deva: आकाशो ह वा एष देवो वायुरग्निरापः पृथिवी वाङ्मनश्चक्षुः श्रोत्रं च

lines.iast: te prakāśyābhivadanti
vayam etad bāṇam avaṣṭabhya vidhārayāmaḥ

padaccheda.iast: tasmai saḥ ha uvāca ākāśaḥ ha vai eṣaḥ devaḥ vāyuḥ agniḥ āpaḥ pṛthivī vāk manaḥ cakṣuḥ śrotram ca te prakāśya abhivadanti vayam etat bāṇam avaṣṭabhya vidhārayāmaḥ
padaccheda.deva: तस्मै सः ह उवाच आकाशः ह वै एषः देवः वायुः अग्निः आपः पृथिवी वाक् मनः चक्षुः श्रोत्रम् च ते प्रकाश्य अभिवदन्ति वयम् एतत् बाणम् अवष्टभ्य विधारयामः

translations.text: He said to him: ‘Space is this god, and air, fire, water, earth, speech, mind, eye and ear. Making (their greatness) manifest they declare: it is we who prop up this body and uphold it.’

notes: Śaṅkara: space, air, fire, water and earth are the five great elements that make up the body; speech, mind, eye, ear and the rest are the organs of action and of knowledge. These gods, which are effects and instruments, make their own greatness manifest and speak, vying with one another for the first place. bāṇa: the aggregate of body and organs. avaṣṭabhya: as pillars and the like prop up a palace, not letting it loosen.

sanskrit.deva:
तान्वरिष्ठः प्राण उवाच ।
मा मोहमापद्यथ ।
अहमेवैतत्पञ्चधात्मानं प्रविभज्यैतद्बाणमवष्टभ्य विधारयामीति ।
तेऽश्रद्दधाना बभूवुः ॥ ३ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
tān variṣṭhaḥ prāṇa uvāca |
mā moham āpadyatha |
aham evaitat pañcadhātmānaṃ pravibhajyaitad bāṇam avaṣṭabhya vidhārayāmīti |
te 'śraddadhānā babhūvuḥ || 3 ||

lines.iast: tān variṣṭhaḥ prāṇa uvāca
mā moham āpadyatha
aham evaitat pañcadhātmānaṃ pravibhajyaitad bāṇam avaṣṭabhya vidhārayāmīti
te 'śraddadhānā babhūvuḥ

padaccheda.iast: tān variṣṭhaḥ prāṇaḥ uvāca mā moham āpadyatha aham eva etat pañcadhā ātmānam pravibhajya etat bāṇam avaṣṭabhya vidhārayāmi iti te aśraddadhānāḥ babhūvuḥ
padaccheda.deva: तान् वरिष्ठः प्राणः उवाच मा मोहम् आपद्यथ अहम् एव एतत् पञ्चधा आत्मानम् प्रविभज्य एतत् बाणम् अवष्टभ्य विधारयामि इति ते अश्रद्दधानाः बभूवुः

translations.text: Prāṇa, the chief, said to them: ‘Do not fall into delusion. It is I alone who, dividing myself fivefold, prop up this body and uphold it.’ They did not believe him.

notes: Śaṅkara: the chief: the principal prāṇa. ‘Do not fall into delusion’: do not be proud for want of discernment. ‘Dividing myself fivefold’: making my own division into the functions of prāṇa and the rest. When he had said this they were without belief: how can this be so?

sanskrit.deva:
सोऽभिमानादूर्ध्वमुत्क्रामत इव ।
तस्मिन्नुत्क्रामत्यथेतरे सर्व एवोत्क्रामन्ते ।
तस्मिंश्च प्रतिष्ठमाने सर्व एव प्रातिष्ठन्ते ।
तद्यथा मक्षिका मधुकरराजानमुत्क्रामन्तं सर्वा एवोत्क्रामन्ते ।
तस्मिंश्च प्रतिष्ठमाने सर्वा एव प्रातिष्ठन्ते ।
एवं वाङ्मनश्चक्षुः श्रोत्रं च ।
ते प्रीताः प्राणं स्तुन्वन्ति ॥ ४ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
so 'bhimānād ūrdhvam utkrāmata iva |
tasminn utkrāmaty athetare sarva evotkrāmante |
tasmiṃś ca pratiṣṭhamāne sarva eva prātiṣṭhante |
tad yathā makṣikā madhukararājānam utkrāmantaṃ sarvā evotkrāmante |
tasmiṃś ca pratiṣṭhamāne sarvā eva prātiṣṭhante |
evaṃ vāṅ manaś cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ ca |
te prītāḥ prāṇaṃ stunvanti || 4 ||

lines.iast: so 'bhimānād ūrdhvam utkrāmata iva
tasminn utkrāmaty athetare sarva evotkrāmante
tasmiṃś ca pratiṣṭhamāne sarva eva prātiṣṭhante
tad yathā makṣikā madhukararājānam utkrāmantaṃ sarvā evotkrāmante
tasmiṃś ca pratiṣṭhamāne sarvā eva prātiṣṭhante
evaṃ vāṅ manaś cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ ca
te prītāḥ prāṇaṃ stunvanti

padaccheda.iast: saḥ abhimānāt ūrdhvam utkrāmate iva tasmin utkrāmati atha itare sarve eva utkrāmante tasmin ca pratiṣṭhamāne sarve eva prātiṣṭhante tat yathā makṣikāḥ madhukara-rājānam utkrāmantam sarvāḥ eva utkrāmante tasmin ca pratiṣṭhamāne sarvāḥ eva prātiṣṭhante evam vāk manaḥ cakṣuḥ śrotram ca te prītāḥ prāṇam stunvanti
padaccheda.deva: सः अभिमानात् ऊर्ध्वम् उत्क्रामते इव तस्मिन् उत्क्रामति अथ इतरे सर्वे एव उत्क्रामन्ते तस्मिन् च प्रतिष्ठमाने सर्वे एव प्रातिष्ठन्ते तत् यथा मक्षिकाः मधुकर-राजानम् उत्क्रामन्तम् सर्वाः एव उत्क्रामन्ते तस्मिन् च प्रतिष्ठमाने सर्वाः एव प्रातिष्ठन्ते एवम् वाक् मनः चक्षुः श्रोत्रम् च ते प्रीताः प्राणम् स्तुन्वन्ति

grammar.en: past passive participle m. nom. pl.

translations.text: Out of indignation he made as if to go out upwards. As he went out, all the others went out, and when he settled, all settled. As all the bees go out after their king when he goes out, and all settle when he settles, so did speech, mind, eye and ear. Pleased, they praise prāṇa.

notes: Śaṅkara: seeing their want of belief, prāṇa, out of pride, went out upwards as it were, in anger, caring for nothing. What happened as he went out the text makes plain by an example. As soon as he was going out, all the other breaths, the eye and the rest, went out; and when prāṇa settled, was still and did not go out, all were still. So in the world bees follow their own king. Speech, mind, eye, ear and the rest gave up their want of belief, understood the greatness of prāṇa and, pleased, praise him.

sanskrit.deva:
एषोऽग्निस्तपत्येष सूर्य एष पर्जन्यो मघवानेष वायुः ।
एष पृथिवी रयिर्देवः सदसच्चामृतं च यत् ॥ ५ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
eṣo 'gnis tapaty eṣa sūrya eṣa parjanyo maghavān eṣa vāyuḥ |
eṣa pṛthivī rayir devaḥ sadasac cāmṛtaṃ ca yat || 5 ||

lines.iast: eṣo 'gnis tapaty eṣa sūrya eṣa parjanyo maghavān eṣa vāyuḥ
lines.deva: एषोऽग्निस्तपत्येष सूर्य एष पर्जन्यो मघवानेष वायुः

lines.iast: eṣa pṛthivī rayir devaḥ sadasac cāmṛtaṃ ca yat
lines.deva: एष पृथिवी रयिर्देवः सदसच्चामृतं च यत्

padaccheda.iast: eṣaḥ agniḥ tapati eṣaḥ sūryaḥ eṣaḥ parjanyaḥ maghavān eṣaḥ vāyuḥ eṣaḥ pṛthivī rayiḥ devaḥ sat asat ca amṛtam ca yat
padaccheda.deva: एषः अग्निः तपति एषः सूर्यः एषः पर्जन्यः मघवान् एषः वायुः एषः पृथिवी रयिः देवः सत् असत् च अमृतम् च यत्

translations.text: He burns as fire; he is the sun; he is the rain-cloud, he is Indra; he is the wind; he is the earth, he is food, the god (of all the world); he is what has form and what has none, and what is the nectar of immortality.

notes: Śaṅkara, introducing the hymn: how do they praise him?

Śaṅkara: this prāṇa, as fire, burns; as the sun he shines; as the rain-cloud he rains; as Maghavan, Indra, he protects creatures and seeks to slay asuras and rākṣasas; he is the wind, in its divisions of āvaha, pravaha and the rest. He is the earth, he is rayi, the god of all the world. sat is what has form, asat what is formless; amṛta is that which keeps the gods in being. What need of more?

sanskrit.deva:
अरा इव रथनाभौ प्राणे सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् ।
ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि यज्ञः क्षत्रं ब्रह्म च ॥ ६ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
arā iva rathanābhau prāṇe sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam |
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni yajñaḥ kṣatraṃ brahma ca || 6 ||

lines.iast: arā iva rathanābhau prāṇe sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
lines.deva: अरा इव रथनाभौ प्राणे सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्

lines.iast: ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni yajñaḥ kṣatraṃ brahma ca
lines.deva: ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि यज्ञः क्षत्रं ब्रह्म च

padaccheda.iast: arāḥ iva ratha-nābhau prāṇe sarvam pratiṣṭhitam ṛcaḥ yajūṃṣi sāmāni yajñaḥ kṣatram brahma ca
padaccheda.deva: अराः इव रथ-नाभौ प्राणे सर्वम् प्रतिष्ठितम् ऋचः यजूंषि सामानि यज्ञः क्षत्रम् ब्रह्म च

words.meaning: in the nave of a chariot wheel

grammar.en: past passive participle n. nom. sg.

translations.text: Like spokes in the nave of a wheel, all is established in prāṇa: the ṛc verses, the yajus formulas, the sāman chants, the sacrifice, the ruling power and the priestly power.

notes: Śaṅkara: everything from faith down to name (the sixteen parts, 6.4) rests in prāṇa alone while it lasts. So do the three kinds of mantras, the sacrifice that they accomplish, the kṣatra that protects all, and the brahma that is entitled to perform sacrifice and other rites: this prāṇa is all.

sanskrit.deva:
प्रजापतिश्चरसि गर्भे त्वमेव प्रतिजायसे ।
तुभ्यं प्राण प्रजास्त्विमा बलिं हरन्ति यः प्राणैः प्रतितिष्ठसि ॥ ७ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
prajāpatiś carasi garbhe tvam eva pratijāyase |
tubhyaṃ prāṇa prajās tv imā baliṃ haranti yaḥ prāṇaiḥ pratitiṣṭhasi || 7 ||

lines.iast: prajāpatiś carasi garbhe tvam eva pratijāyase
tubhyaṃ prāṇa prajās tv imā baliṃ haranti yaḥ prāṇaiḥ pratitiṣṭhasi
lines.deva: तुभ्यं प्राण प्रजास्त्विमा बलिं हरन्ति यः प्राणैः प्रतितिष्ठसि

padaccheda.iast: prajāpatiḥ carasi garbhe tvam eva pratijāyase tubhyam prāṇa prajāḥ tu imāḥ balim haranti yaḥ prāṇaiḥ pratitiṣṭhasi
padaccheda.deva: प्रजापतिः चरसि गर्भे त्वम् एव प्रतिजायसे तुभ्यम् प्राण प्रजाः तु इमाः बलिम् हरन्ति यः प्राणैः प्रतितिष्ठसि

translations.text: As Prajāpati you move in the womb, and it is you who are born in the likeness (of father and mother). To you, O prāṇa, who abide with the breaths, these creatures bring tribute.

notes: Śaṅkara: you who are Prajāpati move in the womb and are born in the likeness of father and mother; since you are Prajāpati, that you are mother and father is already established. The sense is: one prāṇa, under the guise of the forms of all bodies and of those who own them, you are the Self of all. These creatures, men and the rest, bring you tribute through the doors of the eye and the other senses. It is fitting that they do so to you who abide in all bodies with the eye and the other breaths, for you are the enjoyer and all else is yours to enjoy.
The e-text reads pratiṣṭhasi; it is set right here to pratitiṣṭhasi, as the bhāṣya has it.

sanskrit.deva:
देवानामसि वह्नितमः पितॄणां प्रथमा स्वधा ।
ऋषीणां चरितं सत्यमथर्वाङ्गिरसामसि ॥ ८ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
devānām asi vahnitamaḥ pitṝṇāṃ prathamā svadhā |
ṛṣīṇāṃ caritaṃ satyam atharvāṅgirasām asi || 8 ||

lines.iast: devānām asi vahnitamaḥ pitṝṇāṃ prathamā svadhā
ṛṣīṇāṃ caritaṃ satyam atharvāṅgirasām asi

padaccheda.iast: devānām asi vahni-tamaḥ pitṝṇām prathamā svadhā ṛṣīṇām caritam satyam atharva-aṅgirasām asi
padaccheda.deva: देवानाम् असि वह्नि-तमः पितॄणाम् प्रथमा स्वधा ऋषीणाम् चरितम् सत्यम् अथर्व-अङ्गिरसाम् असि

translations.text: For the gods you are the best carrier (of oblations); for the fathers you are the first offering of food; you are the true working of the seers (the senses), the Atharvāṅgirases.

notes: Śaṅkara: for the gods, Indra and the rest, you are the best bringer of oblations. The svadhā, the food given to the fathers at the nāndīmukha śrāddha, comes first, before the rite in which the gods are chief; the sense is that you bring that too to the fathers. The seers are the breaths, the eye and the rest, which are Aṅgirases and Atharvans, for scripture says ‘prāṇa is Atharvan’. Their caritam, their working, which is satyam, unfailing, the service of holding up the body and the like, is you.

sanskrit.deva:
इन्द्रस्त्वं प्राण तेजसा रुद्रोऽसि परिरक्षिता ।
त्वमन्तरिक्षे चरसि सूर्यस्त्वं ज्योतिषां पतिः ॥ ९ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
indras tvaṃ prāṇa tejasā rudro 'si parirakṣitā |
tvam antarikṣe carasi sūryas tvaṃ jyotiṣāṃ patiḥ || 9 ||

lines.iast: indras tvaṃ prāṇa tejasā rudro 'si parirakṣitā
tvam antarikṣe carasi sūryas tvaṃ jyotiṣāṃ patiḥ

padaccheda.iast: indraḥ tvam prāṇa tejasā rudraḥ asi parirakṣitā tvam antarikṣe carasi sūryaḥ tvam jyotiṣām patiḥ
padaccheda.deva: इन्द्रः त्वम् प्राण तेजसा रुद्रः असि परिरक्षिता त्वम् अन्तरिक्षे चरसि सूर्यः त्वम् ज्योतिषाम् पतिः

translations.text: You are Indra, O prāṇa; by your might you are Rudra; you are the protector on all sides. You move in the sky; you are the sun, the lord of lights.

notes: Śaṅkara: Indra: the supreme Lord. By your might, your valour, you are Rudra, destroying the world; and while it lasts you alone, in your gentle form, are its protector on all sides. You move in the sky without ceasing, by rising and setting; you are the sun, the lord of all lights.
In the e-text the bhāṣya on this mantra stands in place of its second half and within the first; the mantra is restored here from the words that the bhāṣya glosses.

sanskrit.deva:
यदा त्वमभिवर्षस्यथेमाः प्राण ते प्रजाः ।
आनन्दरूपास्तिष्ठन्ति कामायान्नं भविष्यतीति ॥ १० ॥
sanskrit.iast:
yadā tvam abhivarṣasy athemāḥ prāṇa te prajāḥ |
ānandarūpās tiṣṭhanti kāmāyānnaṃ bhaviṣyatīti || 10 ||

lines.iast: yadā tvam abhivarṣasy athemāḥ prāṇa te prajāḥ
ānandarūpās tiṣṭhanti kāmāyānnaṃ bhaviṣyatīti

padaccheda.iast: yadā tvam abhivarṣasi atha imāḥ prāṇa te prajāḥ ānanda-rūpāḥ tiṣṭhanti kāmāya annam bhaviṣyati iti
padaccheda.deva: यदा त्वम् अभिवर्षसि अथ इमाः प्राण ते प्रजाः आनन्द-रूपाः तिष्ठन्ति कामाय अन्नम् भविष्यति इति

translations.text: When you rain down, then these creatures of yours, O prāṇa, are full of joy, thinking: there will be food to our desire.

notes: Śaṅkara: when, having become the rain-cloud, you rain. He first reads prāṇate as a verb: then, getting food, these creatures breathe, that is, go about the business of living. Or else: O prāṇa, these creatures of yours, who are your own self and are nourished by your food, are, at the mere sight of your raining, as if they had reached happiness, thinking that there will be food as much as they wish.

sanskrit.deva:
व्रात्यस्त्वं प्राणैकर्षिरत्ता विश्वस्य सत्पतिः ।
वयमाद्यस्य दातारः पिता त्वं मातरिश्व नः ॥ ११ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
vrātyas tvaṃ prāṇaikarṣir attā viśvasya satpatiḥ |
vayam ādyasya dātāraḥ pitā tvaṃ mātariśva naḥ || 11 ||

lines.iast: vrātyas tvaṃ prāṇaikarṣir attā viśvasya satpatiḥ
vayam ādyasya dātāraḥ pitā tvaṃ mātariśva naḥ
lines.deva: वयमाद्यस्य दातारः पिता त्वं मातरिश्व नः

padaccheda.iast: vrātyaḥ tvam prāṇa ekarṣiḥ attā viśvasya sat-patiḥ vayam ādyasya dātāraḥ pitā tvam mātariśva naḥ
padaccheda.deva: व्रात्यः त्वम् प्राण एकर्षिः अत्ता विश्वस्य सत्-पतिः वयम् आद्यस्य दातारः पिता त्वम् मातरिश्व नः

words.meaning: a vrātya, one outside the rites
the Ekarṣi fire; the sole seer
of what is to be eaten

translations.text: You are unconsecrated (pure by nature), O prāṇa; you are the Ekarṣi fire, the eater, the lord of all that is. We are the givers of what you are to eat; you, O Mātariśvan, are our father.

notes: Śaṅkara: vrātya: being the first-born, with no other to perform the rites of consecration for you, you are unconsecrated; the meaning is that you are pure by your own nature. Ekarṣi: you are the fire named Ekarṣi, well known to the followers of the Atharvaveda, and as that the eater of all oblations. satpati: the lord of all that exists, or the good lord. We are the givers of the oblation that you are to eat. ‘You are our father, O Mātariśvan’; or else: you are the father of Mātariśvan, the wind. So it is established that you are the father of the whole world.
The e-text reads prāṇaikaṛṣirattā; it is set right here to prāṇaikarṣir attā, as the bhāṣya has it.

sanskrit.deva:
या ते तनूर्वाचि प्रतिष्ठिता या श्रोत्रे या च चक्षुषि ।
या च मनसि संतता शिवां तां कुरु मोत्क्रमीः ॥ १२ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
yā te tanūr vāci pratiṣṭhitā yā śrotre yā ca cakṣuṣi |
yā ca manasi saṃtatā śivāṃ tāṃ kuru motkramīḥ || 12 ||

lines.iast: yā te tanūr vāci pratiṣṭhitā yā śrotre yā ca cakṣuṣi
lines.deva: या ते तनूर्वाचि प्रतिष्ठिता या श्रोत्रे या च चक्षुषि

lines.iast: yā ca manasi saṃtatā śivāṃ tāṃ kuru motkramīḥ
lines.deva: या च मनसि संतता शिवां तां कुरु मोत्क्रमीः

padaccheda.iast: yā te tanūḥ vāci pratiṣṭhitā yā śrotre yā ca cakṣuṣi yā ca manasi saṃtatā śivām tām kuru mā utkramīḥ
padaccheda.deva: या ते तनूः वाचि प्रतिष्ठिता या श्रोत्रे या च चक्षुषि या च मनसि संतता शिवाम् ताम् कुरु मा उत्क्रमीः

past passive participle f. nom. sg.

translations.text: That form of yours which is established in speech, which is in the ear and in the eye, and which is spread through the mind: make it gracious. Do not go out.

notes: Śaṅkara: the form of yours that is in speech, acting as the speaker; that in the ear and in the eye; and that which runs through the mind in intending and its other workings: make it śivā, calm. Do not go out: the sense is, do not make it ungracious by going out.
The e-text reads yā śrotraṃ; it is set right here to yā śrotre, as the bhāṣya has it.

sanskrit.deva:
प्राणस्येदं वशे सर्वं त्रिदिवे यत्प्रतिष्ठितम् ।
मातेव पुत्रान्रक्षस्व श्रीश्च प्रज्ञां च विधेहि न इति ॥ १३ ॥
sanskrit.iast:
prāṇasyedaṃ vaśe sarvaṃ tridive yat pratiṣṭhitam |
māteva putrān rakṣasva śrīś ca prajñāṃ ca vidhehi na iti || 13 ||

lines.iast: prāṇasyedaṃ vaśe sarvaṃ tridive yat pratiṣṭhitam
māteva putrān rakṣasva śrīś ca prajñāṃ ca vidhehi na iti
lines.deva: मातेव पुत्रान्रक्षस्व श्रीश्च प्रज्ञां च विधेहि न इति

padaccheda.iast: prāṇasya idam vaśe sarvam tridive yat pratiṣṭhitam mātā iva putrān rakṣasva śrīḥ ca prajñām ca vidhehi naḥ iti
padaccheda.deva: प्राणस्य इदम् वशे सर्वम् त्रिदिवे यत् प्रतिष्ठितम् माता इव पुत्रान् रक्षस्व श्रीः च प्रज्ञाम् च विधेहि नः इति

grammar.en: past passive participle n. nom. sg.

translations.text: All this (here) is in the power of prāṇa, and all that is established in the third heaven. Protect us as a mother her sons; grant us prosperity and wisdom.

notes: Śaṅkara: in this world everything, whatever there is to enjoy, is in the power of prāṇa alone; and of what is established in the third heaven, the enjoyments of the gods and others, prāṇa too is the lord and protector. So protect us as a mother her sons. śrīḥ: the glories of the brāhmaṇa and of the kṣatriya have you for their cause; grant us those glories (the word is taken as śriyaḥ) and the wisdom that depends on your staying.
Śaṅkara, closing the praśna: thus prāṇa, whose greatness has been made known by the praise of speech and the other breaths as the Self of all, is ascertained to be Prajāpati, the eater.
